summary: Medici is a fast three-round auction game where players bid on shiploads of goods, trying to build the most valuable cargo in a couple of commodities. It's simple to teach, plays quickly, and the tension comes entirely from knowing when to stop bidding and let someone else overpay.
praised: easy to teach and short playtime
criticised: luck of the card reveals can swing results
can feel a bit dry or repetitive for some
player elimination-ish feel if you fall behind on money

interaction.kind: once-around auction bidding against each other for the same cards
interaction.detail: Every card set is bid on by all players simultaneously in a single pass, so each bid is aimed directly at denying rivals a valuable set or set-majority bonus. The only shared resource is the auction itself, but since the entire game consists of nothing but these auctions, interaction is constant and central.
interaction.said: Part of Knizia's 'auction trilogy'; players describe it as tense bidding where you're constantly reading opponents' cash and driving prices up to hurt them, not just to win the lot

scoring.how_you_win: Win by ending the three rounds of auctioning cargo cards with the highest combined total of goods values plus majority bonuses for holding the most of each commodity type.
scoring.score_note: higher player counts push scores up
